acquisition.description: Shiverthorn is a type of herb which appears as an icy-blue flower.
Boreal Wood is a type of wood harvested from Boreal trees found naturally growing in the Snow biome
Palm Wood is a type of wood harvested from Palm trees found naturally growing in the Ocean biome and Oasis biome.
The Vicious Mushroom is a type of mushroom growing on Crimson grass or Crimson Jungle grass, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing of any weapon or tool.
